First: out of every 100 rupees a student pays for online study, 90 rupees are yours. Second: out of every 100 rupees earned by course content you made, 7 rupees are yours, for life, and after you, for your nominee.
ui.लाइव क्लास (Live Class) की फीस आप ख़ुद त: You set the fee for your live classes yourself, just not below the minimum set by ACS.

ui.कोर्स ख़ुद का बनाया हो — किसी की नक़ल नह: The course must be your own work, not a copy of anyone else's.
ui.महिलाओं और बच्चों की सुरक्षा के कानूनों: Full respect for the laws that protect women and children (POSH/POCSO).
ui.पुश्तैनी या अनुभव-सिद्ध हुनर हाथ-से-हाथ: Someone who teaches a family or experience-proven skill hand to hand: dairy or fish farming, tailoring, machine repair, music practice, any craft. No degree is needed; proof of your work is needed. Three ways to earn: for face-to-face teaching, 90 out of every 100 rupees of the fee are yours; for content made from recordings of your teaching, 7 out of every 100, for life; for running only the practical part of someone else's course on your own, 80.
ui.पहचान हुनर से — अपने काम की फ़ोटो ही आपक: You are known by your skill: photos of your work are your certificate.

ui.अपने विद्यार्थियों को छूट देने की सुविधा: You can give discounts to your students.

ui.संपर्क सिर्फ़ डैशबोर्ड से; झूठी नौकरी-सू: Contact only through the dashboard. Action is taken against false job posts.
